latest_release.name: release-0.97.2
latest_release.body:
This is a patch release for compatibility with the new R6A revision of the MEGA65 PCB (September 2025).

It does not offer any new features or bugfixes, except compatibility for changed components.

Please download the release packages from filehost:
- [mega65r6 incl. ROM](https://files.mega65.org?id=CoreMEGA65R6) (requires login)
- [mega65r6 without ROM](https://files.mega65.org?id=CoreMEGA65R6norom)

You can find issues associated with this release by checking [Project 0.97.2](https://github.com/orgs/MEGA65/projects/9/views/2).
